name: Transpordiamet (Estonian Transport Administration)
notes: Transpordiamet (Transport Administration) was created on 1 January 2021 by merging the Civil Aviation Administration, Road Administration and Maritime Administration, as stated on transpordiamet.ee/en, and carries the aviation and aviation safety remit (transpordiamet.ee/en/aviation-and-aviation-safety, which handles aviation certificates and applications). The page does not use the words 'civil aviation authority'; the role is inferred from that remit and the merger statement. The logo is the header SVG served by transpordiamet.ee (tier 2, website-served): coat of arms, wordmark and a Ukraine-solidarity ribbon, on a white rectangle, stored unchanged as served. No brand page or terms located, so redistribution rights are not confirmed.
